outcomeReason: The exact existing Parent Android test APK passed installation, Parent-only authority, linked synthetic context, lifecycle restoration, biometric separation, reboot, logout, and uninstall/reinstall checks on Steve's Samsung. No production system was contacted and no runtime defect was found. The result remains Amber because token refresh and remote revocation were not safely provable within the no-mutation boundary.
remainingRisk: An independently observed physical token refresh and a safely orchestrated remote revocation journey remain outstanding. Both require a separately bounded method that cannot affect live Auth or overclaim immediate token invalidation.
recommendedNextAction: Accept the exact APK as device-validated for the completed Parent journeys, then decide whether a separate test-only Auth fixture and short access-token expiry are worth creating to prove refresh and remote revocation without any live database exposure.
